title: pm-dispatch: a project seat can sit with no hourly patrol routine and nothing notices — make the patrol a step of seat-online, record it in the seat post, and flag an on-duty lane's unclaimed pm:queue card
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ① the maintainer asked about this incident: 「28560 等了4 个小时，是你的技能有什么问题吗」 and 「为什么会停了定时巡查，skills 是否需要优化」 (2026-11-01 10:23Z / 10:29Z, project thread). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`marchtian`), the seat that missed it. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈唤醒〉 and `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈坐席〉 / 〈停止条件与待命〉, `references/seat-post-protocol.md` L66, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "patrol seat hourly", "巡查", "seat patrol trigger" → only seat posts and #9857 (the half-state patrol view). No card about a missing seat patrol.
reach: any project seat. Measured on spec seat 4 (#18917), 2026-11-01. #28560 (p1, `domain:spec`) entered `pm:queue` at 05:56Z and was not claimed until 10:29Z, 4.5 h later, while the seat was on duty with 0 cards in hand.

## What happened (measured from the seat's own session)

- The seat never created the hourly patrol routine at any point in its tenure (since 2026-10-29 15:26Z). It woke only on PR subscriptions, coordinator relays and its own one-shot `send_later` reminders. That is the "`send_later` 链" the skill forbids.
- When its last PR merged (2026-10-31 23:30Z), the queue was empty. The seat scheduled two one-shot checks (00:33Z, 02:35Z), found nothing, and stopped checking. It wrote "不再定时查" on its checklist.
- The skill already says the right thing in three places, and the seat broke all three:
  - SKILL.md:72: 项目席唤醒 = PR 订阅 + 每项目一个自建自绑巡查 routine; ⛔ 无 `send_later` 链;
  - `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉: 常设座位队列清空不等于退场，是切换待命姿态;
  - `seat-post-protocol.md:66`: 项目席巡查默认每小时.
- Why the text did not hold:
  - Creating the routine is not a step of `seat-online` (seat-lifecycle L41), so taking the seat never asks for it.
  - The seat post carries no patrol line, so neither the maintainer nor triage can see that a seat has none.
  - Nothing measures an on-duty lane whose `pm:queue` card sits unclaimed.
  - The agent's generic habit ("after a few checks with no change, stop polling") overrode the seat rule. The skill does not say that it outranks that habit.

## Wanted

1. **`seat-online` includes the patrol.** Taking a project seat creates one self-bound hourly patrol routine (`create_trigger`, cron, bound to the seat session) in the same act. The `seat-online` record and the seat post carry `Patrol: <trigger_id> · <cron>`. `seat-offline` deletes it in the same act as the clock-out brief.
2. **Empty queue is standby, not a stop.** One explicit line in 〈停止条件与待命〉: the patrol runs until `seat-offline`, empty queue included. "Back off and stop after N quiet checks" never applies to a seat's patrol. Only the maintainer's order or clock-out stops it.
3. **A report-only measurement** in `check-half-states.mjs`, or the triage daily sweep:
   - (a) a seat post 🟢 with no `Patrol:` line;
   - (b) a `pm:queue` card of a lane with an on-duty seat that has spare concurrency, unclaimed for over 2 h.

   Both are printed as readings, not gates (instrument-discipline).
4. **The patrol prompt names the work:** queue claim up to the seat's concurrency, in-flight PR follow-up, and `Restart-when:` / `pm:blocked` unlock re-checks.

## Not here

The seat-4 patrol itself was created at 2026-11-01 10:31Z: hourly at :48, routine `Spec seat 4 hourly patrol`. #28560 is claimed (6556731523).

Links back: #18917, #28560, SKILL.md:72, `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉, `seat-post-protocol.md:66`.
